name: solhonesty
description: Advertised versus realized yield for Solana stablecoin products, with a comparability gate. Zero runtime dependencies.
$comment:test: Bare `node --test` discovers the suite itself. The previous form passed a quoted glob, which the shell handed to node literally, and node only learned to expand a glob in --test at version 21. On node 20 it therefore failed with 'Could not find test/*.test.mjs' and took the nightly refresh down four times before anyone looked. Discovery works from node 18 up, so the engines floor below is true again rather than aspirational.
